summary: legal checked in 6 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for searchwoot.com public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible evidence work. Recommendation: keep the private gate, keep permission outreach unsent, and authorize no rights-dependent display, alerts, affiliate/advertising use, tracking expansion, deployment, or external outreach. Evidence: Woot documentation establishes API access but not redistribution rights; current public terms restrict commercial/public listing, price, derivative, and data-mining uses. Human counsel is required before any rights-dependent request or launch decision.

Fleet legal/compliance disposition: conditional for bounded reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, affiliate disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and data-handling boundaries; blocked for security-sensitive public exposure and unsupported monetization expansion. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. Analytics is broadly healthy but data quality is yellow because source permissions or collector errors remain, including documented Search Console 403s. Revenue is partial: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21; aggregate income is not site-attributable. Do not treat incomplete telemetry or unattributed revenue as zero.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active for searchwoot.com: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 remain open. Existing evidence includes official Woot API, terms, support records, repository/configuration artifacts, privacy and cookie-policy artifacts, and draft terms. No task closes because rights, field-level provenance, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness, and rollback evidence remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle covering the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.

Data-use review decisions: Woot API deal and price-history data is blocked because rights for storage, transformation, historical derivatives, public display, caching, alerts, trademarks, images, prices, affiliate use, and advertising are not evidenced and current public terms point against the proposed use. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed pending a deployed data-flow, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor, consent, and unsubscribe record. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed pending deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed pending a log-field, retention/access, vendor/DPA, incident, and data-subject-request inventory. Human counsel is required for the rights-dependent item and any future affiliate or advertising use.

Site and launch decision: keep scaffold and parked properties private or preview-only until concrete ownership, compliance, analytics, security, accuracy, measurement, and rollback evidence is attached. The available site evidence supports no go-live proposal. Do not publish, configure analytics, monetize, alter DNS, add credentials, or deploy solely because a site is queue-ready or technically scaffolded.

Continue only existing measurement, finance attribution reconciliation, failure repair-or-close review, security evidence capture, and launch-readiness evidence. Do not create duplicate proposals, experiments, telemetry, deployments, requeues, spending, dependencies, monetization changes, or outreach. Preserve the aggregate $4.92 commission as unattributed and all missing costs, permissions, controls, and outcomes as unknown.
